workload: one logical 10 MiB read (host localhost, capacity 1024 MiB)

notes.pgas_slot: 163840 x 64B CXL_SHM_REQ_READ; full run very slow due to per-line calculate_latency; use microbench + prior 64B throughput
notes.pgas_mmap_direct: client memcpy from PGAS pool, no slot RPC (upper bound, not QEMU path)
notes.shm_no_10mb_single_op: PGAS slot data buffer is 64B; cannot do one 10MB RPC today

pgas_slot_10mb_hot_sequential_scaled.method: 4096 sequential slot ops in 1.16ms, scaled (optimistic, same lines hot)

rdma_cxl_theory_reference.note: Order-of-magnitude from line-rate and small-message latency literature; not OCEAN measured
rdma_cxl_theory_reference.small_message_rtt_us_typical: 2-5 (RDMA READ/WRITE over IB); CXL.mem fine-grain often tens of ns–µs in papers, platform-dependent

comparison_summary.motivation_path: tcp_cacheline or pgas_slot (~0.3-6 s for 10 MiB)
comparison_summary.vs_rdma_line_rate: TCP bulk localhost within same order as 64-100 Gbps line-rate bound (~0.8-1.3 ms); cacheline paths orders of magnitude slower than line rate because of 163840 round trips
comparison_summary.vs_rdma_small_msg: PGAS p50 0.4us RTT per 64B is below typical RDMA 2-5us; 10MB still slow unless bulk/zero-copy
